basis: US national-average installed unit costs (material + labor + equipment incl. the installing subcontractor's O&P, like RSMeans 'Total incl. O&P'), Q3-Q4 2025 dollars, location index 1.00. Anchored on the Linbeck Q3 2025 Construction Market Forecast (Texas sub prices, adjusted up toward national) and RSMeans-typical magnitudes escalated to 2025; steel and aluminum items carry 5-10% for 2025 tariffs (steel mill PPI +13% y/y, aluminum +23% y/y, AGC/BLS Sept 2025). Excludes GC general conditions, fee, contingency and escalation.

sog.note: 4000 psi ready-mix $146-170/CY (Linbeck Q3 2025) ≈ $3.0-3.4/SF for 6"; plus placing & trowel finish, WWF, vapor barrier, forms/curing and sub O&P; matches the RSMeans 6" reinforced SOG assembly (~$9-10/SF). Excludes granular base.

lwc_fill.note: ~4.25" average LW concrete over 2" deck (0.013 CY/SF): concrete, pumping/placing, finish, WWF and pour stops; Bushwick quotes $5-10/SF for LW topping, low end chosen for a repetitive 3-storey pour.

floor_deck.note: RSMeans-typical 2" 20-ga composite deck ~$4.5-4.7/SF incl. O&P (2024), +~7% for 2025 sheet-steel tariffs.

roof_deck.note: RSMeans-typical 1-1/2" Type B 20-ga roof deck ~$3.5-3.7/SF incl. O&P (2024), raised for 2025 tariffs.

steel_framing.note: Linbeck Q3 2025: fabricated steel supply $4,028-4,350/ton + erection $1,728-2,100/ton = $5,760-6,450/ton installed; RSMeans-typical W12-W16 beams ~$5,300-5,600/ton. Excludes fireproofing and deck.

steel_columns.note: Same Linbeck basis; heavy W10x49 columns carry fewer connection hours per ton, ~5% below beams. Includes base/cap plates and splices.

stair.note: RSMeans-typical steel pan stair with concrete-filled treads, ~4' wide, incl. stringers and landings ~$600-700/riser (2024), escalated; ≈ $8,500 per flight. Railings priced separately.

railing.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 05 52 13.50 steel pipe railing, 1-1/2": wall rail ~$40-50/LF, 2-rail stair guard ~$65-80/LF, guardrail ~$100-120/LF; blended.

roofing.note: 60-mil fully adhered EPDM ~$4.5-5.5 + 4" polyiso ~$4.0-4.5 + cover board ~$1.5-2.0 + flashings/edges ~$1.5-2.0 per SF; small roof pushes toward the upper middle.

eifs_wall.note: 6" studs ~$7-8 + glass-mat sheathing ~$2.5-3 + batt ~$1.5 + air/water barrier ~$1.5-2 + drainage EIFS ~$14-17 = ~$27-31/SF; RSMeans/BIA study ranks EIFS-on-stud lowest-cost cladding. Excludes interior finish.

core_wall.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 04 22 10.14 8" CMU (~$14-15/SF) + vertical reinforcing and grouted cells (~$4-5/SF).

partition.note: Linbeck Q3 2025 frame & gyp $7.02-9.60/SF; RSMeans-typical 1-hr 3-5/8" stud, 5/8" Type X each side ~$9-9.5/SF; plus primer + 2 coats paint both sides ~$2-2.5/SF.

toilet_partition.note: Vendor $275-375 per door/panel/pilaster, ~3-4 parts + hardware per compartment, plus install; aligns with RSMeans-typical $1,000-1,400.

curtain_wall.note: Linbeck Q3 2025 curtain wall $99-103/SF (Houston/Dallas/Austin); national set slightly higher given +23% aluminum PPI. Stick-built, thermally broken, 1" low-E IGU.

cw_vent.note: Estimated from comparable manufacturer project-out awning vent inserts for 2-1/2" x 6" curtain wall; adder over the curtain-wall SF rate.

window.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 08 51 13 commercial aluminum windows with IGU; cross-checked at ~65-70% of the curtain-wall rate.

translucent_panel.note: Kalwall-type systems ran ~$55-75/SF installed mid-2010s, escalated ~35-45% to 2025; proprietary, get a budget quote.

int_door.note: HM frame ~$350-450 + solid-core wood/HM door ~$700-900 + commercial hardware ~$700-900 + finish ~$100, installed.

storefront_door.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 08 41 26 aluminum entrance door leaf 3'x7', medium stile, IGU, pivots, panic/push-pull, closer; framing carried in curtain wall.

ext_pair_door.note: Two insulated 16-ga HM leaves ~$2,000 + 14-ga frame ~$600 + 2 exit devices ~$1,800 + closers ~$600 + hinges/astragal/threshold/paint ~$700, installed.

act_ceiling.note: RSMeans-typical 2'x2' mineral-fiber tile in 15/16" grid ~$5-6/SF incl. O&P; commercial tegular tile sets $6.00.

water_closet.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 22 41 13.13: wall-hung vitreous china bowl, flush valve, seat; excludes rough-in and carrier.

lavatory.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 22 41 16.13: vitreous china lavatory with commercial faucet, trap and supplies.

urinal.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 22 42 13.40: wall-hung washout urinal with flush valve and trim.

column_cover.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 05 58 13.10 round column covers and GFRC enclosure budget pricing: aluminum ~$100-150/VLF, GFRC ~$130-200/VLF.

fascia.note: Estimated from comparable RSMeans 07 71 19 prefinished 0.050 aluminum / 24-ga steel fascia, 12" face, ~$32-45/LF.

markups.note: General conditions 8-12% for a small 3-storey job; GC fee 5-10%; 10-15% design contingency at schematic level (AACE / ASTM E2516 practice). Escalation not included.

location_factor.note: Typical RSMeans CCI for zip prefix 394 (labor-driven); confirm against the current annual CCI table.
